prompt:
这是IP形象设计之角色关系卡。 核心目的：展现角色与伙伴/对手的相处机制。卡片内容：主角与搭档姓名、一句话互动模式。

本次输入：【填写角色外观或参考图、要保持的辨识特征、各区具体内容】。
有事实、名称、数字或引文时，按输入使用；信息缺失的模块留空或省略。
promptEnglish:
This is the IP Character Design Character Relationship Card. Core purpose: Demonstrate the interaction dynamics between the protagonist and their companion/rival. Card content: Protagonist and partner names, one-sentence interaction mode.

Inputs: [Provide character description or reference image, identifying features to retain, and content for each section].
Use supplied facts, names, numbers and quotations. Leave sections without data blank or omit them.

inputNote: 复制前填写角色外观或参考图、要保持的辨识特征、各区具体内容。成图后核对内容对应位置、阅读顺序和文字。
